name: claude-peer
description: Proactively collaborate with Claude Code as one half of a bidirectional, recursion-safe Codex and Claude bridge.

interface.shortDescription: Fable-first Claude at max effort with verified fallback.
interface.longDescription: Adds the Codex-to-Claude half of a local bidirectional bridge. Codex can invoke a proactive full Claude Code agent for in-scope work, while the companion Claude Code plugin lets an interactive Claude window invoke a policy-bound Codex peer. Both directions use persistent bounded sessions, explicit uncapped modes, independent verification, and technical recursion prevention.
defaultPrompt: Bring in the full Claude Code agent with Fable at max effort, verify the observed model evidence, and implement and test this with you.
Use Opus 5 at max effort for this task and report any model fallback.
Explain and verify the reciprocal Claude-to-Codex bridge.
